purpose: Bind Bootstrap's JSA-style in-scope continuation to explicit reassessment and protected activation boundaries.

jsa.rule: Bootstrap may continue declared local setup work without a second approval prompt when the source, intent, scope, and host readbacks remain unchanged.
jsa.scope_change_rule: A changed scope, changed intent, changed source observation, unresolved soft boundary, or protected action returns to reassessment before dependent work continues.
jsa.soft_boundary_rule: A soft boundary pauses only the affected outcome for a fresh owner choice or Orchestrator review.
jsa.hard_boundary_rule: A hard boundary stops the dependent outcome and preserves its evidence.
jsa.protected_activation_rule: JSA never authorizes publication, push, merge, deployment, rollback, spending, authentication, secrets, destructive overwrite, Product custody, or the protected generic CAMPAIGN_ACTIVATION action; the recorded source-bound local AgentOS campaign start is separately in scope.

exact_plan_approval.rule: The exact approval route remains available when the owner or host requires a separate approval of the complete plan digest.

binding: The safety analysis is content-addressed and included in the exact Bootstrap plan and typed Project Context.
